description: Opt-in: automerge lock file maintenance of Python package managers once every status check is green. Extend it with `local>nicebots-xyz/renovate-config:automerge-python-lockfile`. Pair it with a package manager cooldown (e.g. PDM `[tool.pdm.resolution] exclude-newer`), as Renovate cannot apply `minimumReleaseAge` to lock file maintenance.
